description: Create 1-10 DB users atomically (POST /mysql/v1/clusters/{clusterName}/users/batch-create → 202 Operation). Validation failures come back as 400 partialFailure with per-index failures; an existing name fails the whole batch (409). Use dryRun=true to preview (passwords masked).

clusterName.description: Cluster name (3-30 chars, lowercase letters/digits/'-', no leading or trailing '-'; immutable after creation)

password.description: 8-20 chars with a letter, a digit and a special character; ` & + \ " ' / and spaces are not allowed. Never returned by the API

name: ncloud_serverless_batch_create_users
